# CalculatesAll

CalculatesAll provides free browser-based calculators and utility tools. Calculator inputs are processed in the user's browser. Results are estimates where the page states assumptions or limitations.

## Main pages

- Homepage: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/
- EMI and loan repayment calculator: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/emi-calculator/
- Zakat calculator: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/zakat-calculator/
- Adult BMI calculator: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/bmi-calculator/
- Discount calculator: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/discount-calculator/
- Profit and loss calculator: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/profit-loss-calculator/
- Age calculator: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/age-calculator/
- Unit converter: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/unit-converter/
- Calculation methodology: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/methodology/
- About: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/about/
- Editorial policy: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/editorial-policy/
- Privacy policy: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/privacy/

## Usage notes

The EMI calculator is a planning estimate and is not a bank offer or approval. Zakat calculations use the stated silver Nisab method and may not cover every scholarly view. BMI is a screening measure for adults, not a diagnosis. Read each tool's formula, assumptions, and limitations before relying on its result.
